title: U.S. House · South Carolina's 7th District
area: South Carolina's 7th Congressional District (Myrtle Beach/Pee Dee region)

context.text: Both major-party primaries were canceled after only one candidate filed in each: incumbent Russell Fry (R) and John Vincent (D) each advanced without a primary contest.

candidates.name: Russell Fry
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced without a primary after the Republican primary was canceled

summary.text: Russell Fry is the incumbent U.S. Representative for South Carolina's 7th District, seeking re-election.

background.text: Born in Surfside Beach, SC; lives in Murrells Inlet, SC. Earned a B.A. in political science from the University of South Carolina (2007) and a J.D. from Charleston School of Law (2011).
Worked as an attorney with Coastal Law, LLC before being elected to Congress.

record.text: As of the 2023-2024 session, served on the House Committee on the Judiciary (Constitution and Limited Government; Courts, Intellectual Property, and the Internet; Crime and Federal Government Surveillance subcommittees) and the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform (Government Operations and the Federal Workforce; Health Care and Financial Services subcommittees).

candidates.researchNotes: Ballotpedia's profile for Fry did not list a distinct 2025-2026 committee-assignment table separate from 2023-2024 at the time of research; no current-cycle stated positions were located within the research budget. Key floor votes and FEC totals are added separately by script.

candidates.name: John Vincent
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced without a primary after the Democratic primary was canceled

summary.text: John Vincent is a retired U.S. Navy Command Master Chief and small business owner running as the Democratic nominee for South Carolina's 7th Congressional District.

background.text: Born in Arkansas. Served in the U.S. Navy for 20 years, retiring as a Command Master Chief. Earned a degree from the University of Arkansas at Grantham.
Built and ran a small business after retiring from the Navy.

priorities.text: Fighting wasteful federal spending while protecting vital programs, and supporting increased border security alongside what he calls a fair immigration system.
Championing tax relief for working families, job creation through community-college partnerships, cutting red tape for small businesses, and making healthcare more affordable.
As a Navy veteran, improving VA healthcare, expanding veterans' housing programs, and enhancing education and job-training benefits for veterans.

positions.summary: Supports increased border security paired with what he describes as a fair immigration system.
positions.quote: support increased border security alongside a fair immigration system

positions.summary: Says he will work to make healthcare more affordable and improve VA healthcare for veterans.
